name: Polesinesuchus
sum: Polesinesuchus is a small stagonolepidid aetosaur from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Supersequence of southern Brazil, perhaps a juvenile of Aetosauroides.
wsnote: The holotype is about 76 cm long and probably a two-year-old juvenile (English Wikipedia), so no adult range is given.
holotype: A partially articulated partial skeleton from the Santa Maria Formation, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
biology: The sources consulted describe a juvenile individual but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Roberto-da-Silva et al. 2014

sources.text: L. Roberto-da-Silva, J. B. Desojo, and S. F. Cabreira, A. S. S. Aires, R. T. Mueller, C. P. Pacheco, S. Dias-da-Silva. 2014. A new aetosaur from the Upper Triassic of the Santa Maria Formation, southern Brazil. Zootaxa 3764(3):240-278
